The '''Whiphid script''' was a writing system used by the [[Whiphid/Legends|Whiphid]] race.
It consisted in an elaborate, somewhat elegant cursive style, with a lot of curves, arabesques and dots. [[Norun Gep]] and [[Fillin Ta]], the owners of [[Gep's Grill]], would advertise both in Whiphid script and in [[High Galactic/Legends|High Galactic alphabet]].<ref name="Guide">''[[Galaxy Guide 7: Mos Eisley]]''</ref>
